_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 2: continuous-close + flux analysis. Declares the 11 registers (PeriodStatus, AutoAccrualRule, AutoAccrualPosting, CloseChecklistTemplate, CloseChecklistInstance, FluxRun, FluxItem, FluxAttribution, MaterialityPolicy, ContinuousCloseAlert, CloseMetrics) for.010 of the bookkeeping-continuous-close spec. PeriodStatus carries a five-stage x-openregister-lifecycle (open → soft-closed → hard-closed → audited → locked) with stage-change history; the soft-close transition is the entry point for OCA\Shillinq\Service\SoftCloseExecutor (ADR-031 orchestration exception). CloseChecklistInstance carries a pending → in-progress → completed lifecycle with task-dependency enforcement and SLA escalation. AutoAccrualPosting carries a posted → reversed lifecycle linked to the original entry + reversal entry. GLTransaction.post is additively augmented with PeriodStatusGuard:postingAllowed enforcing the stage-based posting restrictions without dropping any existing precondition. Sibling to bookkeeping-period-close (FiscalPeriod). Both schemas coexist: FiscalPeriod is the T1 entity, PeriodStatus extends it with continuous-close stages.

PeriodStatus.title: Period Status
PeriodStatus.description: Continuous-close lifecycle wrapper around a FiscalPeriod. Carries the five-stage lifecycle (open → soft-closed → hard-closed → audited → locked), stage-change history, owner-per-stage, and posting-restriction flags. Posting into hard-closed/audited/locked stages is rejected by PeriodStatusGuard:postingAllowed unless the actor holds controller-override + exception-journal privilege. Sibling to the T1 FiscalPeriod entity; both can co-exist (FiscalPeriod is the period entity, PeriodStatus extends it with the continuous-close stage model).

stageChangeHistory.description: Append-only audit trail of stage transitions; each entry is {fromStage, toStage, actor, timestamp, reason} (ADR-022).

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: The date and time for timestamp.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The reason or justification for this state or action.

stageChangeHistory.title: Stage Change History

ownerPerStage.description: Owner role per stage; e.g. {soft-closed: 'Controller', hard-closed: 'CFO'}.
ownerPerStage.title: Owner Per Stage

postingRestrictionsPerStage.description: Posting restriction map. Keys are stage names; values are {allow: ['accrual-reversal','correction'], requireOverride: bool}.
postingRestrictionsPerStage.title: Posting Restrictions Per Stage

soft-closed.label: Soft-closed
soft-closed.description: Soft-close job completed; only accrual reversals + corrections allowed.

hard-closed.label: Hard-closed
hard-closed.description: Operator manual transition; no posting except via controller override + exception journal.

actions.description: Stamp softClosedAt=now on the soft-close transition.

hardClose.label: Hard-close
hardClose.description: Lock period for any posting except controller override.

actions.description: Stamp hardClosedAt=now on the hard-close transition.
Stamp auditedAt=now on the audited transition.

lock.label: Lock
lock.description: Year-end terminal lock; no further posting.

actions.description: Stamp lockedAt=now on the locked transition.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: PeriodStatus stage transitions (open → soft-closed → hard-closed → audited → locked) MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: each transition controls which postings are permitted into the period; the stage change history + actor + timestamp is the canonical audit evidence.

AutoAccrualRule.title: Auto-Accrual Rule
AutoAccrualRule.description: Declarative auto-accrual rule executed nightly by SoftCloseExecutor. Carries calculation method (fixed-amount, percentage-of-revenue, straight-line-from-contract, days-elapsed-of-period, external-lookup), reversal pattern (first-of-next-month, on-receipt-of-invoice, on-settlement), frequency, lifecycle state, and a JSON calculationParameters bag for method-specific inputs. Each execution emits an AutoAccrualPosting linking rule version + resulting JournalEntry for audit trail.

calculationParameters.description: Method-specific parameters; e.g. {amount: 1200000} for fixed (integer-cent), {rate: 0.03, sourceField: 'revenue_mtd'} for percentage.
calculationParameters.title: Calculation Parameters

ruleVersion.description: Monotonic version stamped onto each AutoAccrualPosting for audit.
ruleVersion.title: Rule Version

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: AutoAccrualRule changes (target GL account, calculation method, parameters, reversal pattern, lifecycle state) MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: each AutoAccrualPosting snapshots the ruleVersion at posting time so audit can reconstruct exactly which rule produced any historical accrual.

AutoAccrualPosting.title: Auto-Accrual Posting
AutoAccrualPosting.description: Append-only audit record per AutoAccrualRule execution. Carries ruleId + ruleVersion + periodId + integer-cent amount + journalEntryId + postedAt + postedBy + reversalId. Lifecycle: posted → reversed. Once posted the original record is preserved; the reversal links back to the original posting and emits a fresh JournalEntry per IAS 8.

ruleVersion.description: Snapshot of AutoAccrualRule.ruleVersion at posting time.
ruleVersion.title: Rule Version

amountCents.description: Posted amount in integer cents (money-as-cents per ADR-001 fleet rule).
amountCents.title: Amount Cents

journalEntryId.description: FK to JournalEntry written by the accrual.
journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

reversalId.description: FK to the reversal AutoAccrualPosting once reversed.
reversalId.title: Reversal ID

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Accrual is live in the trial balance.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Reversing entry has been posted; original entry preserved for audit.

reverse.label: Reverse accrual
reverse.description: Mark the accrual as reversed; original entry preserved.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: AutoAccrualPosting is append-only audit evidence / ADR-022 /: original posted entry MUST be preserved when a reversal is recorded; the reversal links back to the original via reversalId.

CloseChecklistTemplate.title: Close Checklist Template
CloseChecklistTemplate.description: Reusable list of close tasks per administratie type (BV, NV, eenmanszaak); instantiated per period as a CloseChecklistInstance. Each task carries owner, dueBefore, dependsOn (task-dependency graph), and evidenceRequired flag.

administrationTypeId.description: FK to administration type (BV, NV, eenmanszaak).
administrationTypeId.title: Administration Type ID

taskId.title: Task ID
taskId.description: The identifier of the associated task.

taskName.title: Task Name
taskName.description: The name of the associated task.

dependsOn.title: Depends On
dependsOn.description: A list of depends on entries.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: CloseChecklistTemplate changes (task list, owners, due-before, dependsOn, evidenceRequired) MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: close procedures are an SOX-relevant control; auditors trace which template version produced each CloseChecklistInstance.

CloseChecklistInstance.title: Close Checklist Instance
CloseChecklistInstance.description: Per-period instantiation of a CloseChecklistTemplate. Carries per-task status (pending | in-progress | completed | overdue), owner override, completedAt, evidence attachment, and slaBreach flag. Lifecycle: pending → in-progress → completed with SLA escalation on overdue.

taskId.title: Task ID
taskId.description: The identifier of the associated task.

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of this record.

completedAt.title: Completed At
completedAt.description: The date and time for completed at.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: CloseChecklistInstance per-task state (status, owner, completedAt, evidence, slaBreach) MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: task completion is internal-control evidence; the audit trail captures who completed what and when, including SLA breaches.

FluxRun.title: Flux Run
FluxRun.description: A single variance-analysis execution. Carries scope (administratie, segment, cost centre), comparison basis (budget | forecast | prior-period | prior-year), materiality thresholds, runTimestamp, status, and resultSummary aggregating the FluxItem outcomes.

scopeFilter.description: Free-form filter (segment id, cost-centre code) when scope is segment/cost-centre.
scopeFilter.title: Scope Filter

materialityAbsoluteCents.description: Absolute floor in integer cents per MaterialityPolicy.
materialityAbsoluteCents.title: Materiality Absolute Cents

resultSummary.description: Aggregated outcomes: {materialCount, autoExplainedCount, ownerExplainedCount, escalatedCount, totalVarianceCents}.
resultSummary.title: Result Summary

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: FluxRun (scope, comparison basis, materiality thresholds, runTimestamp, status) MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: variance analysis feeds the board pack; auditors trace which run produced which narrative and against which baseline.

FluxItem.title: Flux Item
FluxItem.description: Per-GL-account variance row of a FluxRun. Carries budget/actual/variance in integer cents, percentage variance, materiality classification, autoExplanation, ownerExplanation, status, and owner SLA. Status lifecycle: open | auto-explained | owner-explained | escalated | accepted.

autoExplanationCoverage.description: Fraction of variance covered by auto-explanation (0.1).
autoExplanationCoverage.title: Auto Explanation Coverage

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: FluxItem variance figures, materiality classification, auto-explanation, and owner explanation MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: owner explanations are SOX-relevant attestations; the audit trail captures who explained what.

FluxAttribution.title: Flux Attribution
FluxAttribution.description: Driver decomposition of a FluxItem variance. One row per driver (volume | price | mix | fx | one-off) with quantified contribution in cents and percentage share.

contributionCents.description: Signed contribution to the variance in cents.
contributionCents.title: Contribution Cents

percentage.description: Share of the total variance attributable to this driver (0.1).
percentage.title: Percentage

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: FluxAttribution driver decomposition MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: explained variances are the quantitative backing for the flux narrative; auditors review individual driver contributions.

MaterialityPolicy.title: Materiality Policy
MaterialityPolicy.description: Per-administratie + per-account-group materiality thresholds. Absolute floor (integer cents) + percentage floor; the max of both applies. Special-rule overrides for cash, tax, revenue groups (typically lower thresholds).

accountGroupCode.description: GL account group code (operational, cash, tax, revenue, ...).
accountGroupCode.title: Account Group Code

absoluteThresholdCents.title: Absolute Threshold Cents
absoluteThresholdCents.description: The numeric value for absolute threshold cents.

percentageThreshold.title: Percentage Threshold
percentageThreshold.description: The numeric value for percentage threshold.

cash.title: Cash
cash.description: A structured cash object with nested properties.

absoluteThresholdCents.title: Absolute Threshold Cents
absoluteThresholdCents.description: The numeric value for absolute threshold cents.

percentageThreshold.title: Percentage Threshold
percentageThreshold.description: The numeric value for percentage threshold.

tax.title: Tax
tax.description: A structured tax object with nested properties.

absoluteThresholdCents.title: Absolute Threshold Cents
absoluteThresholdCents.description: The numeric value for absolute threshold cents.

percentageThreshold.title: Percentage Threshold
percentageThreshold.description: The numeric value for percentage threshold.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: A structured revenue object with nested properties.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: MaterialityPolicy thresholds MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: thresholds determine which variances are escalated; auditors verify that no threshold change was used to suppress disclosable variances.

ContinuousCloseAlert.title: Continuous-Close Alert
ContinuousCloseAlert.description: Alert raised by SoftCloseExecutor or the flux engine when a soft-close step fails or a flux SLA breaches. Carries severity, message, routedTo (list of roles), createdAt, and acknowledged flag.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The date and time for administration id.

periodId.title: Period ID
periodId.description: The identifier of the accounting period.

message.example: FX revaluation failed; please review treasury module
message.title: Message

routedTo.description: List of roles or user ids to notify.
routedTo.title: Routed To

createdAt.title: Created At
createdAt.description: The date and time this record was created.

acknowledgedAt.title: Acknowledged At
acknowledgedAt.description: The date and time for acknowledged at.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: ContinuousCloseAlert records (severity, message, routedTo, acknowledged) MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: soft-close failures and SLA breaches are operational-risk events; auditors review who was notified and when the alert was acknowledged.

CloseMetrics.title: Close Metrics
CloseMetrics.description: Close-quality KPI snapshot per administratie + period. Carries time-to-close, post-close adjustment count, audit-correction ratio, flux-SLA compliance, and unexplained flux item count plus a rolling 12-month trend.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The date and time for administration id.

periodId.title: Period ID
periodId.description: The identifier of the accounting period.

postCloseAdjustmentCount.description: Count of entries posted to the period after hard-close.
postCloseAdjustmentCount.title: Post Close Adjustment Count

fluxSLACompliance.description: % of material flux items explained within 24h SLA (0.1).
fluxSLACompliance.title: Flux Sla Compliance

unexplainedFluxItemCount.description: Count of material variances still unexplained at board-pack publication.
unexplainedFluxItemCount.title: Unexplained Flux Item Count

trendData.description: Rolling 12-period trend; each entry {periodId, timeToCloseDays, postCloseAdjustmentCount, fluxSLACompliance}.

periodId.title: Period ID
periodId.description: The identifier of the accounting period.

timeToCloseDays.title: Time To Close Days
timeToCloseDays.description: The numeric value for time to close days.

postCloseAdjustmentCount.title: Post Close Adjustment Count
postCloseAdjustmentCount.description: The count or quantity of post close adjust.

fluxSLACompliance.title: Flux Sla Compliance
fluxSLACompliance.description: The numeric value for flux sla compliance.

trendData.title: Trend Data

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: CloseMetrics KPI snapshots (time-to-close, post-close adjustment count, audit-correction ratio, flux-SLA compliance, unexplained item count, 12-month trend) MUST be audit-trail-immutable / ADR-022 /: these KPIs trend over 12 periods and are presented to the audit committee; tampering with historical KPI values defeats the entire metric.
